query:
SELECT 
  championTokenId,
  championName,
  COUNT(*) AS totalMatches,
  ROUND(AVG(kills), 2) AS avgKills,
  ROUND(AVG(balls), 2) AS avgBalls,
  ROUND(AVG(wartDistance), 2) AS avgWartDistance,
  ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN isWinner = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) * 100, 1) AS winRatePct,
  SUM(kills) AS totalKills,
  SUM(balls) AS totalBalls
FROM match_player_stats
WHERE championTokenId IN (4193, 2575, 8579, 4011)
GROUP BY championTokenId, championName
ORDER BY avgKills DESC;
